scope.reason: Recompute the instructions from stored raw so the court's own Poučení label, alone or opening the first instruction, is printed once under the synthesized heading; AST blocks have no separate feature storage. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Signature roles are recomputed from the stored decision through the shared Czech role grammar, which reads the office a judge signs under (the president or a member of an extended or grand chamber, the President of a top court); they have no feature storage of their own. Spell the docket's registry as the row's own ECLI spells it (14 Co, not 14 CO) for the stored docket and the listing identity alike; the case number has no separate feature storage. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. A line break typed inside a paragraph, which the structured entries split and the plain text marks with a carriage return, is read as a space; paragraph text and boundaries are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. Court paragraph numbers are re-read from stored raw: a run that counts up by one from its start to within a closing line of the reasoning's end is numbered however much unnumbered text lies between its numbers, the lead-in before the first number is counted from the end of the operative part, and the one paragraph that opens the reasoning before a printed 2 is numbered 1; paragraph numbers have no feature storage of their own.
